title: Fixed task packages
boundary: A package groups fixed task IDs. It does not assign work or freeze task content. Continue using the existing assignment and review tools.
overlapNotice: Each package is counted separately. The same task may appear in several packages; do not add their totals.
filteredRows: Matching rows: {{count}}. The summary above still covers the full visible package.
filterHint: Open an individual task below. Clear the state filter to continue the whole package.
empty: No work visible in your current scope.
loadFailed: Unable to load current work. Access may have changed. Refresh to retry; old rows have been cleared.
accessChanged: Access has changed or this project is unavailable. The old creation form has been cleared. Refresh to check your current access.
name: Package name
ids: Task IDs (1–1000, separated by spaces or commas)
previewCount: Fixed tasks: {{count}}. Membership cannot be changed after creation. No assignments will be created.
invalidInput: Enter a name and 1–1000 different positive task IDs.
createFailed: Creation could not be confirmed. Retry keeps the same request key and selection. Refresh the list before editing an uncertain request.
keyConflict: This request key identifies different content. Refresh the list before starting a new creation.
tasksUnavailable: Some tasks are no longer available in this project. Edit the selection and preview again.
managerScope: Project scope: sample counts and active assignment counts are separate. Multiple assignees may share a task. Cancelled-source pending reviews are retained.
reviewScope: Only pending, non-self submissions you may review are shown. These counts are not the package total.
ownScope: Only your active assignments are shown. These counts are not the package total.
asOf: Read at {{time}}. Refresh to see current progress.
reviewContext: Pending reviews in package #{{id}} only. Empty or unavailable work stops here. Project-wide review history remains in the project workspace.
